coach_plan_quality.UNKNOWN_DURATION: Some sessions use distance or open duration, so exact weekly time is unknown; known minutes are not the full total.
coach_plan_quality.LONG_SESSION_NOT_REDUCED: The longest recovery/taper session did not shorten; review intensity and recovery cost.
coach_plan_quality.VOLUME_JUMP_REVIEW: Some weekly duration increases exceed 30%; review against recent training. This is not a universal safety threshold.
coach_plan_quality.REPEATED_WEEKS_REVIEW: Three consecutive weeks have identical sessions; confirm intentional maintenance rather than accidental repetition.

coach_safety.urgent_pain: Stop training and do not force painful movement or stretching. Severe pain or restricted movement needs prompt medical assessment, preferably today; chat cannot determine the cause. If you also have chest pain, breathing difficulty, fainting, or new limb numbness or weakness, contact local emergency services now.
coach_safety.open_water: Do not swim alone in open water. Prefer lifeguarded or reliably supervised conditions; use a bright cap and tow float, which do not replace supervision. Check weather, water temperature, currents and safe entry/exit points; cancel if unsure. Pool pace does not guarantee open-water pace.
coach_safety.high_volume: Low heart rate does not make long sessions automatically safe. Before training for hours daily, review recent volume, recovery and symptoms, and build gradually. Do not suddenly increase training just for weight loss or expect a specific heart-rate zone to guarantee fat loss.
